DailyHealthLog.title: DailyHealthLog
DailyHealthLog.description: Tracks a senior user's daily medication checklist (morning, lunch, dinner) and water intake cups for a specific calendar date.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

dateKey.description: Calendar date key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

morningTaken.description: Whether morning medication has been taken.

lunchTaken.description: Whether lunch medication has been taken.

dinnerTaken.description: Whether dinner medication has been taken.

waterCups.description: Number of water cups consumed on this date (0 to 30).

createdAt.description: Creation server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Last update server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/daily_logs/{dateKey}.description: User-scoped daily medication and water intake logs keyed by YYYY-MM-DD.
